title: 汉字拆解 Hanzi Breakdown
description: Character decomposition and memory aids for Song Dynasty vocabulary

components.meaning: a horizontal stroke pressing down on top

characters.breakdown: 一横压在火上面，把火压灭了
characters.memory_tip: A flat lid pressed down on fire — the fire is snuffed out → 灭！

components.meaning: a person hiding or escaping (ancient pictograph)

characters.breakdown: 古字：一个人躲进角落，藏起来不见了
characters.memory_tip: Someone hiding in a corner, gone from view → perished / fled → 亡

characters.breakdown: 丝线（纟）不断地接续下去
characters.memory_tip: Like silk thread (纟) that keeps connecting — one piece after another → continue → 继

characters.breakdown: 一个人挺立着走进大殿
characters.memory_tip: A person standing upright (壬) walking forward (廴) into the palace hall → 廷

characters.breakdown: 用手高举，不肯低头
characters.memory_tip: Hand (扌) raised high (亢), refusing to bow → resist → 抗

characters.breakdown: 我心里有善良（羊），愿意牺牲自己
characters.memory_tip: A sheep (羊) on top of me (我) — sacrifice for what is right → 义

characters.breakdown: 发号施令（令）的那个头（页）
characters.memory_tip: The head (页) who gives commands (令) → leader/commander → 领

characters.breakdown: 用棍子打（攵）打散了财物（贝）
characters.memory_tip: Strike (攵) at valuables (贝) and smash them apart → defeat → 败

characters.breakdown: 走回来，回到原来的地方
characters.memory_tip: Steps going back (彳) to where the sun was → return / recover → 复

characters.breakdown: 力量（力）像泉水一样向上涌出
characters.memory_tip: Strength (力) surging upward like a spring → bravery → 勇

characters.breakdown: 植物中间开出最美的花，出类拔萃
characters.memory_tip: The flower (艹) at the center (央) of all plants — the most outstanding one → 英

characters.breakdown: 树（木）里面有一个核心，那是技术的精髓
characters.memory_tip: A dot at the heart of a tree (木) — the hidden skill inside → technique → 术

characters.breakdown: 用手往下压，把印章盖在纸上
characters.memory_tip: A hand pressing down onto a kneeling figure — stamping a seal → print → 印

characters.breakdown: 用草药（艹）制成的东西，能控制（约）病情
characters.memory_tip: Herbs (艹) that restrain and control (约) illness → medicine → 药

characters.breakdown: 玉石（王旁）里藏着鬼魅般的光芒，珍奇无比
characters.memory_tip: A jade stone (王) with an almost ghostly (鬼) glow — rare and magical → precious gem → 瑰

characters.breakdown: 在高处（京）用行动（攵）成就了出众（尤）的事
characters.memory_tip: Reach a high place (京) through outstanding action (尤 + 攵) → accomplish → 就

characters.breakdown: 树木（木）燃烧着生命的火焰，蓬勃生长
characters.memory_tip: A tree (木) with fire-like energy (火) bursting from leaves (艹) — flourishing gloriously → 荣

characters.breakdown: 无数的丝线（糸）密密麻麻交织在一起
characters.memory_tip: Countless silk threads (糸) all tangled together in abundance → numerous / flourishing → 繁

characters.breakdown: 打开门（卯）用钱财（贝）做生意
characters.memory_tip: Open the door (卯) with money (贝) in hand → trade → 贸

characters.breakdown: 比瓦（瓦）更精致的陶器
characters.memory_tip: Earthenware (瓦) at the next level of refinement (次) → fine porcelain → 瓷

characters.breakdown: 丝线（纟）绕来绕去（周）织成的布
characters.memory_tip: Silk threads (纟) woven all around (周) → silk cloth → 绸
